top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a distinct, well-delimited experimental invention: magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, which removes the light shift and carried optical clocks to about 1e-18, two orders of magnitude beyond caesium. The result is reproduced independently at several national laboratories, so it is mature. It yields physical results (millimetre-scale gravitational redshift, bounds on drifting constants). The two-name allocation to Katori and Ye is stable, and the citation can be scoped to the lattice scheme without claiming the 2005 comb or 2012 single-ion lineages.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my background is astroparticle and hard-X-ray polarimetry instrumentation (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGO+), with no documented tie to optical clocks or topological insulators
